facts.fact: The Local Government Finance Commission describes IRAS as an online and mobile platform through which local governments collect revenue by registration, assessment, billing and payment.
As of October 2023 a total of 124 local governments, nine cities, 21 municipalities and 94 districts, had been rolled onto IRAS, per the article; no total of local governments is given.

systems.owner: Local government finance bodies; developed in 2019 with EU and World Bank support
